summary: End-to-end testing of RxFlow redesign (auth portal + workspace + backend) against the public preview URL. 18/18 backend pytest tests pass. All key UI flows verified: splash auto-redirect, login, workspace stats/filter chips/search/audit-trail/pickup callout/counseling modal, logout, forgot-password page, reset-password invalid-token guard, signup with min-8-char password validation. Severity sorting of drug interactions confirmed (Maria Sanchez intake #1: warfarin+aspirin labeled Major). Audit attribution `by @maria` confirmed in UI and via direct API. One minor data-testid gap was fixed in-place; one minor backend validation bug noted.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects `.test` TLD as 'special-use or reserved name'. Seeded users (maria@rxflow.test, demo@rxflow.test) therefore cannot trigger the forgot-password flow end-to-end — the API returns 422. Demo form surfaces 'Request failed.' Use a real-looking domain (e.g., example.com) in seed users or relax the validator.

action_items: (Optional) Update seeded portal users to use a non-reserved TLD (e.g., maria@example.com) OR loosen the EmailStr validator so the forgot-password demo works for seeded accounts.

(Optional) Consider deduplicating the global-search results section — when searching 'Maria' the page shows 7 'article.intake-card' elements (likely both the search-results panel AND the main list); functional but visually duplicative.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/index.html is a 1900+ line single-file dashboard — exceeds the recommended <700 LOC threshold. Consider splitting components, styles and JS into separate modules for maintainability.

Drug-interaction severity sort is implemented in three places (create_intake, _recompute_intake_interactions, evaluate_intake_interactions); keep _sort_interactions_by_severity() as the single source of truth (already done) — make sure any new write-path uses it too.
Audit trail element previously had id='audit-{id}' but no data-testid — added data-testid='audit-{id}' to match the testing contract.
Token decode now passes options={'verify_sub': False} — good for cross-issuer compatibility but document this clearly; long-term, mint FastAPI-issued tokens with string subs.
seed_data_creation: None new; relied on the 6 seeded intakes already present in /app/pharmacy.db. Tests advance intake #4 forward by one valid status step to verify audit attribution; idempotent and tolerant of current state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://58cc5b94-0f34-4c71-b8c8-ce4456fc1aa9.preview.emergentagent.com. Same-origin: /login, /workspace, /signup, /forgot-password, /reset-password (Node portal); /intakes/*, /health, /config (FastAPI proxied); /api/auth/* (Node portal). Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_rxflow_backend.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_rxflow_backend.py -v). Audit trail container now exposes data-testid='audit-{id}'. Key flows already verified — focus next iteration only on bug fixes if needed.
rca of the issue: Forgot-password 422 on seeded emails: backend uses Pydantic's EmailStr which (via email-validator) rejects RFC 2606 reserved TLDs (.test, .example, .invalid, .localhost). Seed users use @rxflow.test, hence rejected. Fix options: (a) change seed emails to *.com, or (b) replace EmailStr with a custom validator that allows reserved TLDs in dev, or (c) lookup by username instead of email for the demo reset link.
